synapsin-II transfection increased the number of synaptic-like vesicles, the rate of synaptic vesicle fusion, and the amount of ATP released in NG108- 15 cells.

synapsin-II overexpression in NG108- 15 cells increases the synaptic vesicle number and the amount of transmitter release.
